g.text: Namespace "default": the unit of isolation. Workflows of different namespaces do not see each other.
Workflow Execution (one start of a type)
Workflow ID: order-1001, a business key you choose; one open execution per ID
Run ID: a UUID made by the server
same Workflow ID, new Run ID
fields you can filter and sort by
Every step is an event; events are only appended
A Worker replays it to rebuild the state after a restart
Inputs and outputs are Payloads (large ones may be stored in S3)
